opening.evidence: No fixed start event: game start (events/game_start.txt) only builds the separatist planet (fotd_seperatist_planet). Yearly pulse common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:410 fires hidden origin.6000 (events/origin_events_3.txt:2556-2620; weights 6005 1, 6006 1, 6015 2, 6020 2, 6025 20 of 46, otherwise nothing). Other branches are state hooks: contact reports (events/story_events.txt story.1-8 if has_origin), first_contact_finished common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:775 (6044), on_join_federation :3507 (6050), on_becoming_subject :4505-4506, on_war_beginning :2609 (6080), traditions/ascension projects (common/traditions, common/special_projects/00_projects_utopia.txt:26/58), crises (events/crisis*), on_sign_migration_pact :4470 (6200), situation_fotd_terraforming (common/situations/04_first_contact_dlc_situations.txt:82-194).
